steps.code:
# Now let me get all liked songs. I'll paginate through all pages.
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

liked_song_ids = set(song["song_id"] for song in liked_songs)
print(f"Number of liked songs: {len(liked_song_ids)}")
print(f"Liked song IDs: {liked_song_ids}")
